name: Rianlon Corporation
summary: Rianlon Corporation provides anti-aging additives and application technologies for polymer materials industry in China and internationally. The company's products include primary antioxidants, secondary antioxidants, UV absorbers, hindered amine light stabilizers, u-pack, polymerization inhibitors, intermediates, light stabilizers, compound customized products, lubricant additives, cosmetics, and life sciences.
